episode.episode: 7-15-26 - Hour 4 - If BYU defeats Notre Dame and Utah will they go 12-0 this season?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.
episode.episodeDescription: Ben Criddle talks BYU sports every weekday from 2 to 6 pm. transcript_window.text: You can look at the Big Ten and the ACC and see how they match up.

and trying to find student athletes under the general same set of rules, you know, that neither one of them has a huge, you know, a huge booster that's going to walk in and help them create a $50 million roster.

I love the point that you're going to see now how a team like Auburn, who right now nobody really expects to compete for an SEC championship, but could with a Baylor.
games last year where it was like one score losses.

We call this game a kickoff for a cause because ultimately we're trying to help raise money for childhood cancer awareness.

kick on ABC.
